title: This Ant Runs 108 Body Lengths a Second on 140 Degree Sand

scenes.text: This ant runs across 140 degree sand at 108 body lengths a second.
It's the Saharan silver ant, the fastest of all twelve thousand known ant species.
Its top speed is nearly a metre per second. And its legs are only five millimetres long.
At full speed it gallops. All six feet leave the ground for a split second.
It has only about ten minutes a day outside its nest before the heat becomes deadly.
Ten minutes. One mad sprint. 108 body lengths a second.

description:
The Saharan silver ant runs 108 body lengths per second across sand that reaches 60 degrees Celsius.
German researchers filmed it in the Tunisian desert. It is the fastest of the world's roughly 12,000 ant species and gallops with all six feet briefly off the ground.
What is the fastest animal you have ever seen? Comment below.
first_comment: Scale it up: at that pace, a human would cross a football field in under a second. Which animal would you want to race?
